limitations: Names are recovered semantic names, not claimed original source symbols.
Every indexed application entry has at least one direct original/rebuilt ARM case; entry coverage is not exhaustive input, branch, timing or concurrency coverage.

Additional and graphics entries retain per-evidence method labels: direct entry execution, caller/inlined-body comparisons, composed owned operations, public-field contracts, and an elided no-op are distinguished.
Explicit invalid-ID repair checks are recorded separately from equivalence comparisons.
Hardware and network calls in emulator cases are observed through explicit boundary hooks. No physical appliance/OLED/WiFi/thermal validation is claimed.
Graphics dependency replacement supports Pico display geometry; it is not a general Adafruit_GFX SDK replacement.
